name: Women's Dresses
source:
A very short kinetic novel about an intimidating knight and his love for women's dresses.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/womens-dresses]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部十分简短、没有选项的视觉小说，讲述一位令人望而生畏的骑士，以及他对女式连衣裙的喜爱。

[摘自[url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/womens-dresses]itch.io[/url]]
